description: Authenticates the customer's domain for sending email through i-mailsend (Oracle OCI Email Delivery, eu-frankfurt-1): DKIM CNAME, SPF include merged into the existing SPF record, custom return path (bounce) CNAME, and a monitoring-only DMARC policy. Used only when the domain has no DMARC record yet; otherwise the sending-nodmarc template is used. MX and website records are not touched.
variableDescription: dkimselector: the DKIM selector created for this domain in Oracle Email Delivery (e.g. em202610). The DKIM CNAME target is derived from it: <selector>.<fqdn>.dkim.fra1.oracleemaildelivery.com.
